We are looking for a highly technical AI Engineer with strong full-stack capabilities to architect and build the foundational AI infrastructure and core application layers for our next-generation Smart Audit platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end ownership of the AI lifecycle moving beyond third-party API orchestration to design, train, and deploy proprietary machine learning models natively, while ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into a robust, scalable enterprise web application.

You will transform how the enterprise analyzes financial records, contracts, and operational data, turning manual, error-prone sampling into automated, 100% population risk scanning. If you are passionate about custom architecture, enterprise scalability, and deploying high-performance systems and full-stack applications to production, this role is for you.

## Key Responsibilities

* **Proprietary Model Architecture and Training:** Design, train, and fine-tune domain-specific LLMs and deep learning models for anomaly detection, fraud identification, and automated compliance checking.
* **Full-Stack Application Integration (MERN):** Architect and develop the core platform features using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), ensuring smooth, low-latency communication between the AI backend services and the user-facing dashboard.
* **Custom GenAI and Retrieval Infrastructure:** Engineer advanced, low-latency retrieval systems, custom embedding models, and multi-agent workflows optimized for massive volumes of unstructured legal and financial data, independent of high-level orchestration frameworks.
* **Enterprise Production and MLOps:** Establish automated, end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering data labeling, continuous training, version control, and high-throughput/low-latency model serving in production environments.
* **Data Architecture Engineering:** Architect custom ETL and data ingestion pipelines using Node.js/Express capable of parsing and structuring complex, multi-format enterprise data (unstructured PDFs, massive Excel sheets, ERP system dumps) into MongoDB and vector databases.
* **Evaluation and Robustness Frameworks:** Implement deterministic evaluation frameworks to strictly benchmark model accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, and minimize false positives/negatives in a high-stakes auditing environment.
* **Security, Privacy and Explainability:** Architect systems to comply with strict enterprise data isolation and privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC2). Ensure the React interface provides clear, intuitive, and explainable lineage so human auditors can verify the AI’s logical reasoning.

## Technical Skills and Qualifications

### Required

* **Experience:** Demonstrated track record of building, scaling, and maintaining both machine learning models and production-grade full-stack web applications.
* **MERN Stack Proficiency:** Production-grade development experience with MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, indexing, schema design), Express.js, React.js (state management, hooks), and Node.js (asynchronous programming, API development).
* **Deep Learning and Frameworks:** Professional proficiency with Python and deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch or TensorFlow) along with a strong understanding of neural network architectures.

### Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

* Experience building, fine-tuning, or aligning open-source LLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral) using PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, or DPO.
* Experience designing and optimizing distributed Vector Databases (e.g., Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector) alongside traditional document stores like MongoDB.
* Expertise in customized NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), or building custom OCR/Document parsing pipelines.
* Experience building and scaling AI-driven full-stack solutions or multi-agent orchestrations within Enterprise SaaS, Fintech, or Legaltech.
* Experience with real-time data streaming (e.g., WebSockets, Kafka) to push live AI inference results to a frontend dashboard.

## Soft Skills and Culture Fit

* **First-Principles Thinker:** You look past black-box solutions; you understand how a model behaves at the architectural level and how the application layer interacts with it.
* **System Ownership:** Comfortable owning the technical roadmaps—from the database layout and backend APIs to the AI models and the final user interface.
* **Pragmatic Innovator:** Ability to balance cutting-edge AI agent research with the practical realities of enterprise engineering constraints (cost, latency, UI/UX clarity, and security).

● Build and improve backend services (APIs, data pipelines, and deployment setup)

● Demonstrated history of being a highly effective team player with excellent coding
skills

We're looking for a Support AI Manager to lead the team that builds and safeguards the quality of our AI-powered support bots. This role owns two connected functions: the bot building team (led day-to-day by a build Lead who designs ERDs and manages hands-on development) and the bot monitoring team (with functions including bot functionality audits, bug handling, quality control, and support). You'll manage and scale both, while remaining hands-on enough to personally evaluate bot builds against spec and catch issues before they reach customers.

The what and how of the roadmap are owned by our CX AI Product Manager, who sets priorities and writes the PRDs. Your job is to make sure what gets built actually matches that spec, to define how we test and monitor bots on an ongoing basis, and to make sure quality issues make it back into the roadmap fast. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a purely administrative one — you should be comfortable reviewing a build yourself, not just hearing about it secondhand.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

- Manage and grow the bot building team and the bot quality/monitoring team, including coaching the build Lead as they grow into managing a focused, subject matter expert team of builders.
- Personally review bot builds and version deploys against approved ERDs and PRDs, catching spec drift, gaps, or quality issues before launch.
- Define and own the testing cadence for the team — pre-launch UAT, regression testing, and frequency and scope of live bot audits.
- Own the feedback loop between quality/monitoring findings and the roadmap, making sure issues surfaced by your team get back to the Product Manager and build Lead quickly and are prioritized appropriately.

### Ready to move beyond traditional QA and become an AI-first product engineer?

If you're passionate about evolving from conventional testing into building, automating, validating, and delivering AI-powered products, this opportunity is designed for you.

We're looking for highly hands-on professionals who want to own the complete product journey—understanding requirements, leveraging AI to accelerate engineering, ensuring quality, and shipping production-ready solutions.

This is **not a conventional QA role**. It is an opportunity to future-proof your career and become part of the next generation of AI-first software delivery.

**Apply only if you genuinely meet the below technical, AI engineering, product ownership, testing, and delivery expectations.**

## Overview

We are seeking a highly capable and hands-on **AI-First Product & Testing Engineer** with strong experience in software development, automation, and product validation.

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a **developer, tester, product owner, and end user** to independently understand requirements, validate solutions, automate quality, identify improvements, and drive products from concept to production.

### Testing & Automation

* Define test strategies, quality gates, and release criteria.
* Validate functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end scenarios.
* Design and maintain automation frameworks and reusable test assets.
* Build quality dashboards, validation utilities, and reporting solutions.

### Communication & Delivery

* Prepare and maintain SDLC/STLC artifacts, release notes, and quality reports.
* Confidently conduct demos, walkthroughs, and stakeholder discussions.
* Deliver high-quality releases with strong ownership, accountability, and minimal production defects.

## Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in Software Development, SDET, Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or hybrid Dev + QA roles.
* Experience working within formal SDLC/STLC processes.

## Preferred Technical Skills

**JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, MERN Stack, Playwright, Robot Framework, REST/GraphQL APIs, CI/CD, Git, Agile/Scrum, AWS, AI-assisted engineering tools.**

## What We Value

**AI-native mindset • Ownership • Product thinking • Communication • Continuous learning • Bias for action • Attention to detail • Passion for building market-ready products**

The Opportunity

Most AI roles ask you to apply someone else's research to someone else's problem.
This one is different.

We are building something in the professional productivity space that has not existed before. A new category - not an improvement on what's already out there. The kind of problem that requires original thinking, not fine-tuning.

We are looking for a Chief AI Scientist to be a co-architect of that - someone who will shape the technical soul of the company from day one. This is a founding team role. You will have real equity, real influence, and a real shot at building something that changes how millions of professionals work every day.

What You Will Work On
We cannot say everything here - and that is intentional. What we can tell you:

The core of what we are building is deeply technical and sits at the intersection of speech, language, and real-time inference
You will be working on problems that require novel approaches - not off-the-shelf solutions
You will own the AI research agenda entirely - from architecture decisions to model selection to what gets built next
Your work will be felt by users in the first second they use the product

If you need a detailed spec before you are interested, this is probably not the right role. If the above is enough to make you curious, keep reading.

The Pedigree We Are Looking For

We will be direct. This is a role for someone with an exceptional track record - not potential. We are a pre-seed company asking you to take a risk with us, and we owe you honesty about what that means. In return, we need someone who has already done the hard thing.

Specifically, we are looking for someone who has:
Research depth
— PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Speech Processing, or a related field from a top-tier institution
— Published at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, Interspeech, or equivalent
— A research direction you have genuinely owned - not just contributed to Applied AI experience

Builder mentality

— Has made architecture decisions that turned out to be right

What This Is Not
— This is not a staff research scientist role with a team of 30 beneath you

— You will see the cap table before you decide
